channel.title: NBA quotes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes from NBA players, coaches and executives about each other, with context and sources.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Erik Spoelstra
item.description:
Giannis Antetokounmpo on Erik Spoelstra:

“I think he is a great coach. The little interactions I have had with him, he is an amazing human being. I am excited to play for him. I had a very different perception of him while I was being on the other team. I felt like he was very militant and very tough and maybe bordering like an asshole and pushes his players. But now I feel like he is very supportive, caring, honest. They say that he lets you go, he lets you be yourself and play and do what you really do. He fills you up with confidence.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Erik Spoelstra, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: JJ Redick on Quentin Grimes
item.description:
Quentin Grimes, who had started the first four preseason games and had been solid in his role, was not among them.

“I know that there’s a chance Quentin is gonna have an opportunity to start,”

JJ Redick on Quentin Grimes, Oct 17, 2026. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Hakeem Olajuwon, Wilt Chamberlain
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns:

“I think Hakeem. And I feel like in a way he kind of is like mythical like Wilt Chamberlain. Like, you know, but we have something to watch Hakeem games on, but like it's kind of like that same mythical creature like Wilt, but I've been able to talk and meet Hakeem and he's an amazing human. So I'm very honored to say that.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Hakeem Olajuwon, Wilt Chamberlain, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns:

“I would say the person that's toughest is probably going to be like DeMarcus Cousins or Steven Adams. I've probably in my life ever had to tag the roller. During defense, you're on the other side and you come over to tag the roller to hold him up so he doesn't DeAndre Jordan, alley-oop dunk, Blake Griffin, alley-oop dunk like that, Mitchell Robinson, alley-oop dunk. You try to slow down the roller so it makes it easier to deal with the pick and roll, the player, two offensive players and the two defensive players. It makes it easier and gives them more time to figure out the situation with the PNR.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Masai Ujiri:

“I have to look ahead. When I look ahead, I see a generational player like Cooper Flagg. He's only 19 years old, which makes him a prince. You see the king potential. It's our job to make him there, to get him there, because he is prepared. He's had an incredible summer, he works out, he has the right attitude, right spirit, hopefully a winner.”

Masai Ujiri on Cooper Flagg, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Kevin Durant, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Masai Ujiri:

“Kyrie Irving is one of the finest basketball players to ever walk around the world. I remember Kevin Durant saying there is only one Kyrie walking around the world. I am blessed to have had a relationship with him. Now we find ourselves on the same team. He is coming off injury, but he has had an incredible summer. He is right back at it. His spirit, you can tell he is a very passionate dude. He thinks differently, but inside, Kyrie is a great dude, a great person. All the young players look up to him. He is such a kind person around employees, around everybody.”

Masai Ujiri on Kevin Durant, Kyrie Irving, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Bill Bradley on Earl Monroe
item.description:
“The fact that it has Earl Monroe on the [school] name, that might be a little reason why I’m here, but you guys are the reason that makes my heart full. Earl is the reason of my heart, because he is in my heart,”

Bill Bradley on Earl Monroe, Oct 16, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Chris Finch on Leonard Miller
item.description:
Finch on Miller:

“We love Leonard. We got him super young. He put the work in. We could see growth. Itreally was all about opportunity and he’s getting one here. We’re tickled for him. When you look at our previous roster construction, the pathway for him to play wasn’t clear.”

Chris Finch on Leonard Miller, Oct 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Jimmy Butler on his former teammate Bam Adebayo scoring 83 points:

“Good for him. 83 is a lot of points, and he is a crazy, talented player. He can do everything incredibly well. But it’s always a team effort. Nobody just gets scored 83 on. It’s a team thing, you know, you’re sending double teams. (And a ref thing?) Could be. Double teams, triple teams, whatever. The whole, whatever you call it, shebang, the whole team, the whole book, whatever. And he made shots, a lot of them. So good for him. 83 is historic.”

Jimmy Butler on Bam Adebayo, Oct 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Heat Central:Stan Van Gundy is OUT on the Miami Heat and says Bam Adebayo is overrated.

“I’m not as high on Miami as people are… The shooting they added compromises them badly on the defensive end of the floor. Even though he was great last year, I’m not sold on Davion Mitchell as a full time starting PG… I’d actually be surprised if they were in the top 6… I’m not a fan of their roster. — I think Wiggins is underrated but I think Bam is a little overrated, particularly at the offensive end of the floor. I’m not sold on them.”

Stan Van Gundy on Davion Mitchell, Oct 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony:

“Jaylen Brown is the best two-way player in the NBA…I think if Wemby wasn't in the league, [JB] could win defensive player of the year.”

Carmelo Anthony on Jaylen Brown, Oct 15, 2026. Source: Youtube.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James, Pablo Torre
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony on Pablo Torre:

“You got to take the stand and tell us which owners. Say the owner of the XYZ teams are asking about LeBron’s transportation. F** all that journalism sh**. Like I respect the journalism, but if we're going to keep it a buck, keep it a buck. Tell us who the owners are. Because if we were saying, if a player was saying something about the owners, that owner would find out who the f*** was saying that sh**, and we would be in a situation where we could be f***ed up… It's investigating too much, but I've said this previously that you got what you got, and I don't want you to stop being a journalist, because you do great journalism and I respect you as a journalist.”

Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James, Pablo Torre, Oct 15, 2026. Source: Youtube.

item.title: Devin Vassell on De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Devin Vassell on #Spurs' three-guard starting lineup:

“You don't know who to pick up. It's Fox, it's Dylan, it's Steph. We have five ball handlers that can come down and attack the basket and make a play. I think it's going to be tough for other teams.”

Devin Vassell on De'Aaron Fox, Oct 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Evan Turner on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Jalen Williams
item.description:
Turner continued to say of James.

“You look at the starting five. I don’t see him slowing down. Who’s better? I mean, who’s better? It’s almost like the Stefon Diggs thing. If I’m not the better one, who’s a better number two than me that’s just elite? I think Jalen Williams from OKC is one of the best top 15 players in the world, and I would throw ‘Bron up against him any night. Jalen Williams is elite. LeBron has got five or 10 more years the same way with Kevin Durant. They’re like, ‘Where am I going?’ There’s nothing else to do. This shit is easy.”

Evan Turner on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Jalen Williams, Oct 15, 2026. Source: rotogrinders.com.

item.title: Marcus Sasser on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Mavs guard Marcus Sasser on his first impression of Cooper Flagg:

“He’s amazing man. It’s hard to believe he’s that’s young. He’s so unselfish. He knows the game.”

Marcus Sasser on Cooper Flagg, Oct 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson:

“He walks the talk. He works extremely hard & he strives for perfection. When your peers see you do that & you're looked upon as the best player on the team it gives you credibility to tell somebody else when they're not giving their all”

Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson, Oct 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Bronny James
item.description:
Speaking on his show, Arenas called out media networks and analysts for never holding European players accountable when they fail to meet expectations.

“They was too busy bashing Bronny for nepotism that they forgot there was a No. 1 pick that they never even mentioned,”

Gilbert Arenas on Bronny James, Oct 14, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard a day after agreeing to his contract extension:

“When people think of a Celtic, he’s one of the first people that comes to mind.”

Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard, Oct 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“He likes being Michael Jordan. Even still, when he’s on camera, there’s an aura about Michael Jordan that is just different. Sitting across from him. It’s just a different feel. I think he is above the daily discourse of, ‘Hey, who is the best point guard in the NBA right now?’ and ‘who’s the best this or the best that?’”

Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan, Oct 14, 2026. Source: Front Office Sports.

item.title: Myles Turner on Darvin Ham
item.description:
Myles Turner:

“Darvin Ham has such a great quote after practice the other day, you know, I live downtown and you know, I respect the people, you know, who are out there working construction, it is so loud, you know what I mean? But, you know,those guys are literally out there busting concrete for damn near minimum wage, and we are expected to come out here, keep ourselves in shape, and, you know, play basketball to make the checks that we make. So, I try to keep that perspective no matter where I am at.”

Myles Turner on Darvin Ham, Oct 14, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Steve Kerr on David Stern, Robert Sarver
item.description:
In the midst of answering a question about whether he could ever imagine playing an NBA game in Las Vegas, Kerr said he heard about initial efforts to place a team in the desert two decades ago.

“Twenty-two years ago, I walked into (former NBA commissioner) David Stern’s office in New York with Robert Sarver,”

Steve Kerr on David Stern, Robert Sarver, Oct 14, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: VJ Edgecombe on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
VJ Edgecombe:

“JB is one of my favorite people in the world. He’s a great person, someone that I talk to every day. He’s a leader, he’s just Jaylen Brown. He’s a great person and that’s someone that I just have a really good relationship with, even though we just met a few months ago.”

VJ Edgecombe on Jaylen Brown, Oct 14, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Collin Gillespie on Michael Porter Jr
item.description:
Collin Gillespie:

“Michael Porter Jr. might be the best tough shot maker and workout shooter I have ever seen in my life.”

Collin Gillespie on Michael Porter Jr, Oct 13, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Darius Acuff on Draymond Green
item.description:
Darius Acuff on his interaction with Draymond Green the other night:

“He was telling me read the game a little more... He's playing against, but he's also watching the game, trying to teach me. I was listening... I agreed with him.”

Darius Acuff on Draymond Green, Oct 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: David Roddy on Ja Morant
item.description:
David Roddy:

“First and foremost, I think the media has Ja Morant, his image, completely wrong. He's a great leader. He was vocal from the jump. He took all of our rookies under his wing, my first year. Andhe just has an amazing heart. People don't really, people misunderstand him a lot. It's very easy just because, you know, he's young, he makes mistakes just like everybody else, but people are trying to bash it over his head continually.”

David Roddy on Ja Morant, Oct 13, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: John Collins on Jalen Duren
item.description:
John Collins on his fit with Jalen Duren:

“With our athleticism, our ability to dominate the paint, I feel like it’s going to be fun to play with JD. Especially with his vision, I feel like I have some underrated vision. … Always happy to have another good big fella.”

John Collins on Jalen Duren, Oct 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Free throws, Aday Mara
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Aday Mara shooting 13-of-17 on free throws in preseason:

“That's something that we're working on with him… We're trying to help him build a skillset that can sustain over the course of a long career.”

Mark Daigneault on Free throws, Aday Mara, Oct 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“He likes being Michael Jordan. There’s an aura, even still, when he’s on camera, there’s an aura about Michael Jordan that is just different.“Sitting across from him, it’s just a different feel. And I think he is above the day-to-day conversation of ‘Hey, who’s the best point guard in the NBA right now? And who’s best this or the best that?’“So I think in a controlled setting, talking about topics that he’s still passionate about with the sport, he loved it.”

Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan, Oct 13, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan
item.description:
summit in New York on Tuesday, Tirico explained that Jordan ultimately didn’t want to deal with the day-to-day of a broadcaster at this point in his life.

“I think Michael Jordan hadn’t been on TV for a long time for a reason,”

Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan, Oct 13, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Wendell Carter on Collin Sexton
item.description:
After spending time with the Cavaliers, Utah Jazz, Charlotte Hornets and a stint with the Chicago Bulls, Sexton now brings his high-volume scoring ability (15.4 PPG, 40.1% 3PT) to the Los Angeles Lakers.

“I worked out with Collin Sexton—a guy I grew up with, played AAU with him since I was a kid,”

Wendell Carter on Collin Sexton, Oct 13, 2026. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Wendell Carter on Derrick Favors
item.description:
“Just his determination, his attention to detail, inspired me. And then I got to get on the court a couple times with Derrick Favors up in Atlanta. His touch around the rim is still elite. Yeah, those two guys.”

Wendell Carter on Derrick Favors, Oct 13, 2026. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Finch said of adding Ball.

“Always come in smiling. He and Anthony have a shared quality: they're really hard to stay mad at. And they do some things that you want to get mad at. And they have a reflective joy... We refered to ourselves as a moody team in the last couple of years at times and it's probably gotten in our way. We've traded moodiness for giddiness.”

Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards, Oct 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Deni Avdija on Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Deni Avdija on why it is impossible to guard Nikola Jokic:

“Every time I switch on to Jokic, I’m like, what the hell am I supposed to do? This guy is strong, smart, can pass, and has those touch floaters from every angle.”

Deni Avdija on Nikola Jokic, Oct 12, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on George Floyd
item.description:
Enes Kanter Freedom:

“NBA want us to talk about what's happening in in America or the protest going on, George Floyd, um you know, Black Lives Matter. So, you guys are the voice. You guys are the leaders of our community. So, go out there and talk about it.”

Enes Kanter Freedom on George Floyd, Oct 12, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jordan Poole on Jamahl Mosley
item.description:
“I think something that (Mosley and the coaching staff) have made pretty clear is that defense isn’t just a one-on-one situation. We’re playing defense together as a team. So, the schemes need to be right,”

Jordan Poole on Jamahl Mosley, Oct 12, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jordan Poole on Jamahl Mosley
item.description:
“The communication has been good. I’ve gotten to know Coach Mosley a little bit throughout my years in the NBA. Just having an open line of communication. They want me to be me,”

Jordan Poole on Jamahl Mosley, Oct 12, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Mike Brown on Bruce Brown
item.description:
Mike Brown on what he's liked from Bruce Brown so far in camp:

“It's great that you're able to get vets like him into camp because you get to know them, just as much as their game. He's been doing a nice job. He was with the group a few nights ago ... those guys made a couple of mistakes but they played hard -- not just defensively, moving the ball quickly, etc...”

Mike Brown on Bruce Brown, Oct 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Olden Polynice on LeBron James, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Olden Polynice on how he would react if he was Joel Embiid and LeBron James walks into the locker room and starts setting standards:

“I’ll be like, you ain’t my daddy. You ain’t my daddy you my teammate, you know. You have to respect. Again, the man doesn’t walk on water. I will give you the respect, but that’s about it. You’re still not going to come in and just like dictate stuff. You know, first of all look, the man plays for the 76ers and he’s jumping on helicopters every day going to New York. It’s like how are you spending time with your teammates getting to know them outside of practice, which is something you should be trying to do.”

Olden Polynice on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Oct 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Scott Perry on Ben Simmons
item.description:
After a conversation with Suhr, Kings general manager Scott Perry paid a visit to Miami to watch Simmons work out in late August.

“Around the time he was participating with the Australian national team, I got a couple calls from people in Australia mentioning the fact that Ben Simmons is here and he’s playing really, really well, he looks healthy again and a little bit reminiscent of his days in Philadelphia,”

Scott Perry on Ben Simmons, Oct 12, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Charles Lee on Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Sam Perley:Charles Lee on working with now-Bucks Head Coach Taylor Jenkins in ATL/MIL:

“He was the guy I sat next to on the plane my very first year in the NBA (2014-15), and I was always impressed with how organized he was... He had his sorters - there were red, green, this and that.”

Charles Lee on Taylor Jenkins, Oct 11, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Bennett Stirtz on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Bennett Stirtz:

“Whatever the team needs me to win, I’m going to do. It’s easier when you have the best player in the world (Shai Gilgeous-Alexander) out there to make the game easier for you. Whatever I can do to help everyone else, I’ll do it.”

Bennett Stirtz on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Oct 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Otega Oweh
item.description:
Justin Martinez:Mark Daigneault on what he has seen out of tw o-way rookie Otega Oweh so far:

“Otega has all of the physical tools. He has great physical athleticism, strength and size. He’s a prototype wing defender. He’s got to get the fundamental base down, as all of those guys do.”

Mark Daigneault on Otega Oweh, Oct 10, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Micah Nori on Hansen Yang, Yang Hansen
item.description:
Micah Nori on Hansen Yang:

“I think thathe has done a very good job and his showing has been very well. I think that is where we have the luxury of because with what we are going to do rotation wise and how we are going to play, if we are fully healthy, I don’t know,it may be a spot here and there, maybe a couple bigs, Robert or Donovan get into foul trouble and those type of things and the matchup. So by any means, it is not like we are just counting Hansen out, but if there is an opportunity that arises, we feel very comfortable putting him in the basketball game.”

Micah Nori on Hansen Yang, Yang Hansen, Oct 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Neemias Queta on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Now that Brown has moved to Philadelphia this summer, their friendship will have to coexist with their rivalry.

“I've dunked on everybody on the court. Jaylen Brown is the only one left,”

Neemias Queta on Jaylen Brown, Oct 10, 2026. Source: A Bola.

item.title: Toumani Camara on Scoot Henderson
item.description:
Toumani Camara on Scoot Henderson:

“To me, he put it together. Scoot always been super athletic, super fast, great finisher, great driver, great shooter, and I feel like now mentally he just put it all together. How can he affect the team defensively, how scrappy he could get, and offensively make the right play every time. I think there’s no one time this summer where I’m like, ‘You should have done this, Scoot.’ Every time he drive and making a decision, it’s the right one and it’s the one that we need for the team.”

Toumani Camara on Scoot Henderson, Oct 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Adam Silver on Patrick Dumont
item.description:
Adam Silver:

“It's just started. We hired a search firm. Tremendous interest in the job. We are interested in having the women come here. In fact, you were at an event this afternoon and again Patrick Dumont who oversees the property here said, let's get a deal done. So I think I know there's many WNBA teams that would love to play internationally and this is a beautiful arena, it's a great opportunity here so we hope to make that happen fairly quickly.”

Adam Silver on Patrick Dumont, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Miami will need to add layers to what they do on offense as the season progresses, but the first two games suggest Miami could have what it takes to be an even stronger offensive unit this season.

“I mean, last year, we led the league in 140-point games and that’s with no Giannis Antetokounmpo,”

Bam Adebayo on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Oct 9, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Carlos Boozer on Chris Webber, Cameron Boozer
item.description:
Carlos Boozer on his son Cameron Boozer:

“I'm proud of him. First off, first off, I know this has been his dream to be in this position, to be in the NBA and have a chance to play for a team that loves him. And so, I just hope him to take in these moments like be where your feet are. Be present, enjoy these moments because they go by so fast. I still remember my first game against Sacramento back in 2002 when they had Chris Webber. And I was, you know, 20 something years ago. So I just hope him to be where your feet are, be as present as you can be, enjoy every moment, because they go by so fast.”

Carlos Boozer on Chris Webber, Cameron Boozer, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Dean Wade
item.description:
LeBron James on Dean Wade:

“He fits on any basketball team on the planet. You have to have guys like that in order to win, but he could play for any basketball team on the planet and he would fit right in.”

LeBron James on Dean Wade, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Free throws, Amen Thompson
item.description:
Rafael Stone on Amen Thompson:

“I think he's a very, very good basketball player. Since about halfway through his rookie year, we've been a materially better team when he's on the court. And he keeps getting better. I thought he had a really good year last year. He just got better and better and better and better. And he helps our team on the court in literally every way you can. We turn the ball over less, we turn the other team over more, we rebound better, we shoot a higher percentage, we shoot free throws better. Everything's better with Amen Thompson. So yeah, we're very, very high on him.”

Rafael Stone on Free throws, Amen Thompson, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.
